description: This file defines the BlobReporter class, a test report generator that creates ZIP reports with metadata, attachments, and test results, used within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: BlobReporter
classes.description: A class that generates ZIP reports for test results, including metadata and attachments, within the Playwright testing framework.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Sets up report metadata and configures the reporter with the test run configuration.

methods.name: onTestPaused
methods.description: Handles test pause events; currently a no-op.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Finalizes the report by creating a ZIP file containing metadata, attachments, and test results.

methods.name: _prepareOutputFile
methods.description: Prepares the output file path for the report ZIP, creating necessary directories.

methods.name: _defaultReportName
methods.description: Generates a default report filename based on configuration and command hash.

methods.name: _serializeAttachments
methods.description: Serializes test attachments, adding a SHA-1 hash and storing attachment info for ZIP inclusion.
